## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Emily possesses a strong sense of taste and a skill for dressmaking, crafting garments with unmatched fits. She is also known for being obsessively tidy, driven to begin cleaning even in pristine environments.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

In her early life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher before marrying Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). She previously left her husband and returned to her own house after demanding he choose between her and his parrot. Eventually, Emily arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) searching for her husband and travels to his house, bringing news of their reunion to the neighborhood.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +3 more_

>
> — Emily — [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P12](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0012)

> "A friend sent a marked copy to me . . . friends are always so ready to do such things. James A.‘s name was written in over ‘new citizen.’"
>

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Emily forms a lifelong friendship with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) in Volume 2. Following Emily's unexpected arrival in the neighborhood, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) accompanies her back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss Emily's history and character with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), +6 more_
